entries.name: Raspberry Pi 3 Model A+
entries.reason: Raspberry Pi 3 Model A+ exposes its complete forty-contact GPIO interface as two rows of twenty, 2.54 mm apart. The normal upward header is for HATs/cables. Replacing it with a whole downward 2×20 strip would connect independent GPIO/power contacts through the same breadboard conductors; enlarging the breadboard or rescaling the artwork does not resolve that topology. Use a forty-contact breakout/cable adapter.
